publication.source: Acevedo-Limón et al. 2026, Journal of Applied Ecology; Dryad archived 2025-10-16
publication.permissions: Source citation and licence from official record required before any output redistribution

provenance: Prepared using published study methods and public file descriptions, without reading original study CSV outcome rows. Published aggregate conclusions were already known and are NOT newly predicted.
prior_eog: Synthetic EOG BAM sign certificates PR #702; independent NutNet study PR #705 with 2 correct / 1 wrong / 5 abstain on 8 heldout sites. Both immutable and neither is a fourth EOG-WF endpoint.

source_gate.required: Exact filenames, positive file sizes and 32-hexdigit MD5 checksums from authoritative file manifests, each downloaded file independently matches advertised size and MD5
source_gate.if_unavailable: SOURCE_STOP; no mirror accepted without original byte parity
source_gate.no_data_leak: Only filenames, metadata, hashes and CSV column headers are published by source-gate. No outcome values, counts or model scores before source verification.

treatment_analogue.sowing: Artificial seed introduction bypasses natural propagule-arrival limitation for the planted seeds; natural dispersal M is NOT measured.
treatment_analogue.protection: Protected stations exclude vertebrate granivores/herbivores; not complete deletion of all biotic B constraints; cage microclimate effects possible.
treatment_analogue.abiotic: Measured soil/moisture may proxy A; neither abiotic mask nor species physiological niche is directly identified.
treatment_analogue.natural_status: Species natural presence/absence at each forest patch (site_type), not a complete occurrence census with imperfect detection corrected.

response.primary: Per-station germination fraction: confirmed germinations / original sown seeds; compare paired protected vs unprotected stations within same species×site×year×microhabitat×station.
response.paired_effect: For each species×site×year, equally weight complete matched stations and compute mean(germ_fraction_protected - germ_fraction_unprotected); no seed-level pseudoreplication.
response.class: positive iff effect > +0.025; negative iff < -0.025; operational-zero otherwise, not a statistical CI
response.prior_group: Primary natural site_type=='absent'; site_type=='present' predeclared contrast (not pooled).
response.first_summer_secondary: If the seedling_monitoring and seedling_surv coding can be validated against the authors' instructions, calculate station germination probability times conditional survival rate among monitored germinants; if stage coding is ambiguous, STOP only this secondary target.
response.long_term: No multi-year persistence or natural colonization claim.

truth_witness.at_least_one_success_in_natural_absence_: Counterexample to strict stage-specific abiotic establishment impossibility in the experimentally sampled microsite, conditional on true establishment endpoint. Natural arrival limitation remains possible, not proven.
truth_witness.protected_only_success: Positive protected success contradicts strict abiotic impossibility; protected-only vs unprotected-zero is suggestive of vertebrate pressure but not logically proof of a population-level protection effect.
truth_witness.both_zero: No exclusion certificate; germination failure cannot identify A versus B versus seeds/storage/other mechanisms.
truth_witness.never_infer: Source dispersal routes, historical M, complete physiological niche, population persistence, or actual causal effect of B removal from zero observations.

units.primary_recording_unit: station (paired physical plot), not individual seed
units.inference: Ten forest-patch sites are geographic replication units; sites×species and seeds are nested/partially crossed, not independent landscapes.
units.key: species, site, year, microhabitat, station, treatment
units.duplicate_key: STOP on discordant combination; never silently combine or delete
units.germination: Binary 0/1 or documented explicit NA; no arbitrary recoding
units.zero_pair_rule: Report as ineligible; preserve complete flow
units.temporal_replication: Two sowing years only for predeclared subset; do not count as independent patch replication
units.cover_of_moisture: Soil and moisture measured site×microhabitat and station; never use as proof of M.
units.significant_fraction: Do not claim statistical significance from sign unanimity or 61,000 seed count.

predictive_stress.phase: Secondary; only after source gate and exact unit qualification; distinct from truth-witness primary.
predictive_stress.holdout: Hash sorted site names by SHA256('EOG_SEED_WITNESS_20261119|'+site). Take first ceil(0.20*n) eligible sites as holdout; remainder training.
predictive_stress.target: Mean paired protection-minus-unprotected germination-fraction sign for naturally absent species×site×year units
model_worlds: ridge species and fruit-type main effects
predictive_stress.caveat: Models are alternative prediction representations, NOT identified ecological mechanisms; no model agreement alone is a proof of true direction.
predictive_stress.sign_guard: Do not report verified sign without uncertainty intervals excluding zero across all admitted models; otherwise abstain. Fixed 0.025 operational tolerance.
predictive_stress.evaluation: Holdout site-level false sign count, abstention and coverage, baseline, site-clustered uncertainty; no new EOG-WF score.

hard_stops: No official source bytes + verified metadata MD5
Too few geographically independent sites to claim broad generality
No site-level replication for 95%-interval sign test
Outcome-specific target changes forbidden after response access
deliverables: Single-measurement protection contrasts with explicit absences/uncertainty
